# instagram-archiver

Save local copies of Instagram photos and videos that **your own logged-in
account can already see** - a class group, a family account, your own posts -
at full resolution, with metadata, in a folder structure you can hand to
anyone.

[Install](install.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[First archive](quickstart.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

---

## What it does

- Saves **photos at full resolution** - typically 2500-3900 px wide, not the
  640 px preview.
- Saves **videos** when you ask for them, including reels and videos inside
  carousels.
- Walks **every slide of a carousel**.
- Stamps each file with **the post's own date**, so the archive sorts
  chronologically in any file browser.
- Records **captions, like counts, comment counts and reel play counts**, and
  optionally comments and followers.
- Keeps a **CSV/JSON index** per account and never downloads the same file
  twice.
- Can **describe an account without downloading it** - `scan` records what a
  profile posted in about 3 seconds a post, against 30 for archiving.

## What it deliberately does not do

::: {.callout-warning title="The lines this tool will not cross"}

- **No credentials in code or config.** Your password, cookies and session
  tokens are never read, stored or transmitted. You log in by hand in a
  real browser window.
- **No bypassing anything.** Private-account rules, blocks and pending
  follow requests all still apply.
- **No CAPTCHA solving, no anti-bot evasion.**
- **No hammering.** Requests are paced deliberately.

If you need something outside those lines, this is the wrong tool.

:::

## The seven commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`login`](commands.qmd#login) | open a window and wait for you to log in by hand |
| [`profile`](commands.qmd#profile) | archive every visible post on a profile |
| [`post`](commands.qmd#post) | archive one post or reel URL |
| [`scan`](commands.qmd#scan) | record what a profile posted, downloading nothing |
| [`followers`](commands.qmd#followers) | record who follows an account, and what changed |
| [`fill-videos`](commands.qmd#fill-videos) | fetch only the videos an earlier run skipped |
| [`relayout`](commands.qmd#relayout) | rearrange an archive already on disk |

## Please be decent about it

Content other people shared privately with you was shared with *you*.
Archiving it for yourself is not permission to republish it, and the people in
those photos did not agree to anything beyond the audience the poster chose.
